items.html: Understand now and see that although the drop of the female is double the drop of the male, the roots of the female drop are found in the male as well. And the matter is that the drop of the male is YAHU of BON, which is MB as mentioned above, and in it is the root of two drops for the need of AVA, except that since in Atik and Arich the male and female had not yet each been divided and separated on its own, as is known, therefore the root of AVA was still included together in this name YAHU of MB.
